1.original_instruction: Talk to Killtin, the NPC on the left side, inside the Assassin Guild. Continue conversing with him until he teaches you Venom Knife .
1.full_en: Talk to Killtin, the NPC on the left side, inside the Assassin Guild. Continue conversing with him until he teaches you Venom Knife . Job Level: None Class: Assassin

1.short_ru: Поговорите с Killtin в Assassin Guild и изучите Venom Knife.
1.short_en: Talk to Killtin in Assassin Guild and learn Venom Knife.

2.original_instruction: After learning Venom Knife , talk to Esmille(the NPC on the right side). She will teach you the skill only after you've completed a task. Kiltin asks you to retrieve a jewel from either Sphinx B2 or Pyramids 4F.
2.full_en: After learning Venom Knife , talk to Esmille(the NPC on the right side). She will teach you the skill only after you've completed a task. Kiltin asks you to retrieve a jewel from either Sphinx B2 or Pyramids 4F. Job Level: 40 Class: Assassin Skill Requirements: Sonic Blow Level 1
2.full_ru: После изучения Venom Knife поговорите с Esmille, NPC справа. Она обучит вас умению после выполнения задания. В источнике Kiltin просит достать камень в Sphinx B2 или Pyramids 4F. Для этого умения: Job Level 40, профессия Assassin, Sonic Blow Level 1.
2.short_ru: Изучив Venom Knife, обратитесь к Esmille; получите один камень из Sphinx B2 или Pyramids 4F. Требуются Job Level 40 и Sonic Blow Level 1.

requirements.condition: One jewel from any of the three source sites; not a Sapphire+Ruby+Aquamarine shopping list.

branches.condition: Choose this jewel site as one alternative; obtaining all three jewels is not required.
branches.original_instruction: In Sphinx B2, there are two places where you can obtain the gem. You only have to get one jewel from either of these locations (If the first doesn't work go the the second one, and vice-versa). The first coffin site can be found at 1 o'clock (216,268), approximately two screens west of the entrance to Sphinx B3, where there will be a coffin on a raised platform. Walk up to the platform to activate the dialogue and you will be prompted to make a choice. Depending on what you choose you will be poisoned , blinded , or cursed . Just be persistent and continue selecting and eventually you will receive a Sapphire.
branches.short_ru: Вариант Sapphire: в Sphinx B2 подойдите к гробу (216,268); повторяйте попытки до получения камня.
branches.short_en: Sapphire alternative: approach the coffin in Sphinx B2 (216,268); retry until the jewel is obtained.
branches.full_ru: В Sphinx B2 есть два места получения камня; нужен только один камень из любого из этих мест. Если первое не срабатывает, попробуйте второе, и наоборот. Первое место с гробом находится в направлении 1 часа (216,268), примерно в двух экранах западнее входа в Sphinx B3: гроб стоит на возвышении. Подойдите к нему для диалога и сделайте выбор. В зависимости от выбора вы получите отравление, ослепление или проклятие. Продолжайте попытки, пока не получите Sapphire.

reviews.detail: Archived numeric Job Level 40 belongs only to Sonic Acceleration, not Venom Knife. Killtin in step 1 and Kiltin in step 2 differ in source spelling; identity is unresolved, so they remain distinct. Esmille is the stated contact and final teacher. Sonic Blow Level 1 and Venom Knife are separate prerequisites, not a whole-guide self-dependency.

Sapphire, Ruby and Aquamarine are alternative quest-acquired jewels, not a three-item cost. The two Sphinx coordinate pairs have no printed map codes; the Pyramids point is qualitative. Exact trap answers, status durations, item IDs and final jewel consumption are unknown. None of the dungeon names is silently converted to a map code.

routes.condition: Venom Knife training has no numeric Job Level gate in this source.
Sonic Acceleration activity requires learned Venom Knife, Job Level 40 and Sonic Blow Level 1. Stages 3/4/5 are alternative jewel sites; obtain one jewel, not all three.
